title: Democracy at Work in Rural Puerto Rico
summary: A 1942 US government film on farm extension work in Puerto Rico's countryside.
description:
Made by the US Department of Agriculture Extension Service and directed by Chester Lindstrom, this narrated film shows rural Puerto Rico around 1941: coffee and tobacco farms in the highlands, sugar cane on the coastal plains, extension work by the University of Puerto Rico, and 4-H clubs.

A public-domain US government film held by the National Archives, shown as demonstration media while original programming is produced; it is not a Monumental Original. No captions are available yet.

credits.attribution: Democracy at Work in Rural Puerto Rico (1942). US Department of Agriculture Extension Service; directed by Chester Lindstrom. US National Archives, via Internet Archive.

context: A US government film made in wartime. It frames Puerto Rico as an 'outpost of American democracy', takes a paternalistic tone toward the people it shows, and leaves Black Puerto Ricans out of the picture.
